description: `new C()` is a call to the constructor's effective body, so a throw in the constructor is reported at the `new`.

diagnostics.message: Call to `Service` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `Service` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
